<div class='pages'>
	<div class='heading'>
	<h1>Dwallat Adventure <a name='Nirrum's Encyclopedia of Varomar:Plot Notes:Homegroup 2023:Dwallat Adventure'></a></h1>
	</div>

	<div class='content'>
	<p>
Created Saturday 23 December 2023
</p>

<p>
Outside to inside
</p>

<br>

<p>
Actors:<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
The party
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
(yet unnamed)
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
The Thugs - here for a payday, here for food, here for something worse to do<br>
The furi upper Echelons - Also here for a payday, somehow more ravenous<br>
The hidden citizens - Surviving on the entropy of greater powers
</div>
</p>

<p>
<b>The Setting:</b><br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Mesas and plateaus of sandstone, carved by receding waters. Unfortunate heat, holy shade, and unholy denizens. 
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Parts
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
The desert itself<br>
The canyons<br>
Dragon's Roost/War of the dragons --level up <br>
Heart of Dwallat<br>
Hall of the Free king
</div>
</p>

<p>
Treasure to be found<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Desert - nothing save what you kill<br>
Canyon - food and water, limited but needed<br>
Dragon's roost - The help and friendship of many dragons<br>
Heart of dwallat 
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
- Secret gardens of dwallat 
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 90pt'>
- Chromatic Roses
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
- Treasure halls
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 90pt'>
- Low level
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 120pt'>
- armory and artificery
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 150pt'>
-Dagger of denial<br>
- Mariner's armour (lots)<br>
- Tinkertop Boltblaster 1000
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 120pt'>
- Honeypot treasure hall - trapped heavily
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 150pt'>
Sekolahian Worshiping Statuette<br>
Deck of illusions<br>
Cursed items
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 90pt'>
- Medium level 
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 120pt'>
- General use rewards, General use magic
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 150pt'>
Ring of Spell Storing<br>
Stirring dragon-touched foci (many)<br>
Bloodaxe
</div>
</p>

<br>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 90pt'>
High level
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 120pt'>
- Personal armoury<br>
- Greater treasure hall
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 150pt'>
Luxon beacon<br>
Shield of the Hidden Lord<br>
Dragonlance
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
Oristhach's personal effects
</div>
</p>

<br>
<br>

<h3>The desert<a id="the-desert" class="h_anchor"></a></h3>

<br>

<p>
<b>The Path</b><br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Survival rolls, are needed to cross the vast field of sand. Compasses are useless, and certain types of survival rolls get advantage if performed correctly the first time. Lightning frequently strikes the dunes if clouds roll overhead, regardless of rain. The sun shows its unending ire during the day and the moon forever casts its glare unless the party is well prepared. 
</div>
</p>

<p>
<b>Win condition</b><br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Make it to dwallat
</div>
</p>

<p>
<b>Treasure</b><br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Meteoric iron with abberant properties<br>
The corpse of a traveller against a rock with a Lohar of the witch lords and a explorer's pack with no rations or water.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<b>Catches</b><br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
The sun in the daytime is harsh - 2 gallons of water per day<br>
Dragons occasionally patrol the desert, getting spotted makes life harder.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<b>Twists</b><br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Maneleece Milat is hostile to the party and either wants the Arcanohedron or revenge.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<b>Enemies</b><br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Purple Worms<br>
Retriever<br>
Bigger wight?<br>
Mummies
</div>
</p>

<h3><b>The Canyons</b><a id="the-canyons" class="h_anchor"></a></h3>

<br>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>The path</b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
Labyrinthine and extensive canyons stretch for miles. Tall and imposing red sandstone  creates shade and allows for pools of water, while also hiding cracks, crevices, and caves. Reeds and trees hide along secret ponds that have been filled since the receeding seas left dwallat standing as a monument in the desert.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Win Condition</b>: Reach the Dragon's Roost one one of the central mesas in the massif
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Treasure
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
A dropped and buried statuette of a godess made of skilfuly worked marble, streaked with gold and jade, 2000gp
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Catches
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
These places are monitored and unfamiliar.<br>
Alignments are difficult to judge in this place
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Twists</b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
A full, angry, and impatient moon  has corrupted many things, an abberant wave of creatures descends upon the land (see abberations)
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Enemies: </b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
Abberations<br>
a dragon<br>
Desert giant with a grudge
</div>
</p>

<br>

<h3>The Dragon's Stone Eerie<a id="the-dragons-stone-eerie" class="h_anchor"></a></h3>

<br>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>The Path </b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
Where one central mesa lies slightly lower than the rest, the road climbs a steady hill past cave and divot, throne and temple, all built to, for, or by the dragons that cover the landscape. The barren highlands are inhospitable, even for the region, but the road is straight and well travelled.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Win Condition: </b>Enter Dwallat's Heart Alive
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Treasure</b>:
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
The Eye of Teruna, The source stone, Granting just unambiguous immortality<br>
The Favour of the Dragon King
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Catches</b>:
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
It is impossible to get in to dwallat without being seen. <br>
The dragons are at war (Ujira The Lavender and Brelamanibenaweg the Umber)the thin road is barely a safe zone for the denizens of dwallat
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Twists:</b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
This section can be largely bypassed if the party waits for a caravan<br>
Helping end the dragon war means that you are immediately known, and consider a threat by the people inside.<br>
Not helping the dragons may mean the opportunity of stealth<br>
If any Furi operative escapes earlier in the campaign,  or they are unable to clear the psychic sentries before they are noticed, then the furi attack, and on occasion, some dragons may join in the fight
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Enemies</b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
Furi battleminds<br>
Occasional dragon
</div>
</p>

<h3>Heart of Dwallat<a id="heart-of-dwallat" class="h_anchor"></a></h3>

<br>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>The Path</b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
The main road within the heart of the Dwallat has simple branches. The bedlands in one direction, the cafeteria in another, The gates that guard the Main part of the Furi compound, and a trading hall, all worn stone
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Win condition:</b> Pass all gates, Reach the throne and private quarters of Orsithach furi.
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
Twist: Orsithach is nowhere to be found, scrying magic can't find him, the only clues to his location are the teleportation circle in his "quarters"
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Treasure:
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
Access to the pan-universal portal, a relic of the creation of the world<br>
Access to the trains<br>
Access to the Furi artificery and treasure halls<br>
Crazy guns from sci-fi universe
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Catches: 
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
The upper Echelons are all either psychic or magical. <br>
People are constantly, and I do mean constantly, attempting to pickpocket everyone.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
Twists:<br>
 <b>Orsithach furi lives nowhere near this place.</b><br>
The higher ups speak in complete gibberish or not at all
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Enemies:</b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
The entire Furi upper chain of command
</div>
</p>

<br>

<h3>Orsithach's Quarters<a id="orsithachs-quarters" class="h_anchor"></a></h3>

<br>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>The path: </b>Only through magical investigation, traps, or cleverness can the party find Orsithach's Private demiplane, once they are able to find somethign within the demiplane that they can track though, there are very few defenses against them.
</div>
</p>

<br>
<br>
